build: Debug for the first eight observations; final Release for the in-app soak cancellation. Native SwiftUI controls, ad-hoc signing, same recorded phase-3 source.
method: Native app UI automation through CUA; app-process exit was separately verified. Screenshots were inspected inline, not retained as repository images.

observations.scenario: Cold launch with shown and paused saved
observations.observed: Pause stayed on; Refresh reported 1 scene update and no behavior deadline. Closing controls revealed the visible static pet image.
Left and Up changed origin from (1308,92) to (1260,140), 48 points each. A fresh hidden+paused process restored (1260,140), both flags, Quiet Behavior on, and click-through off.
The hidden fresh process remained at 0 scene updates after Refresh. Show while Pause stayed on produced 1 scene update and no resting deadline.

observations.scenario: Cancel quick check after actual diagnostic movement
observations.observed: During the check the measured origin changed to (1014,140). Cancel restored (1260,140), paused=true, hidden=false, clickThrough=false, autonomousBehavior=true and no deadline.

Started from hidden=true and paused=true at (1260,140). The check temporarily used shown/unpaused/click-through/manual-only flags. Native Quit exited with status 0 and pgrep found no Spriglet process. A fresh process restored the original hidden+paused flags, home, Quiet Behavior on, and click-through off.

observations.scenario: Placement edge limits and restoring normal choices
observations.observed: Repeated Right and Down commands stopped at (1308,92) on the current display. Show and Resume returned to visible, unpaused, Quiet Behavior on, click-through off, all-Spaces on and one behavior deadline.

A coordinate click on the dark target increased its blank mouse-down count to 1. A later discrete window-stack prediction differed from the fixture window. Separate app-targeted automation can affect activation/order, so this does not certify cross-app first-click routing or focus retention.

observations.scenario: Physical drag through the UI automation tool
observations.observed: CUA returned noWindowsAvailable when asked to drag the nonactivating pet panel, although it could inspect the panel and image. Directional native controls were used to validate placement persistence. This is a test-tool limitation, not evidence that physical dragging fails.

On Release, started from hidden=true, paused=true, Quiet Behavior off, clickThrough=false and (1260,140). Cancel after reaction activity restored those flags, home, no scheduled deadline, and the cancellation message. The pet was then shown and recentered to (1308,92) for a separate paused/quiet-off GPU capture.

limitations: Single connected display; no real display disconnect/reconnect, resolution change or reboot was tested.
Keyboard traversal/VoiceOver, physical cross-app focus and input, alpha/shadow routing, scroll momentum, Spaces, Stage Manager and actual sleep/wake remain separate manual gates.
No GPU, energy, battery, or production memory budget is established by these UI observations.
